items.body_raw: מָה רַב טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר צָפַנְתָּ לִירֵאֶיךָ פָּעַלְתָּ לַבֹּטְחִים בָּךְ נֶגֶד בְּנֵי אָדָם
items.answer_raw: How abundant is thy goodness, which thou hast treasured up for them that fear thee, (which) thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee, in the sight of the children of men.

items.body_raw: קָבְרוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים קָבוּר שָׁם
items.answer_raw: They buried the corpse of the aged prophet in the grave where the man of God was buried.

items.body_raw: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם
items.answer_raw: Now Deborah, a prophetess, was judging Israel at that time, and she used to sit under Deborah's palm in the hill-country of Ephraim.

items.body_raw: A city shedding blood like water
אָכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַפֶּסַח מָתְנֵיהֶם חֲגֻרִים נַעֲלֵיהֶם בְּרַגְלֵיהֶם וּמַקְלָם בְּיָדָם
items.answer_raw: The Israelites ate the passover with their loins girt, their sandals on their feet, and their staff in their hand.

items.body_raw: Evermore Yahweh supports all who fall.
